title: feat: add real-time notification system
body:
## Summary
Implements a WebSocket-based notification system with the following features:
- Real-time message delivery
- Automatic reconnection with exponential backoff
- Offline message queue
- Read/unread tracking

## Test Plan
- [x] Unit tests for WebSocket client
- [x] Integration tests for notification flow
- [x] Manual testing on staging

Closes #145
author: achen

comments.author: palves
comments.body: LGTM! The reconnection logic looks solid. Just one minor suggestion on the retry delay calculation.

title: fix: resolve OAuth callback race condition
body:
## Problem
Multiple tabs authenticating simultaneously could create duplicate sessions.

## Solution
Added mutex lock for session creation and improved state validation.

## Test Plan
- [x] Added integration test for multi-tab scenario
- [x] Manual testing with 5 concurrent tabs

Fixes #156
author: imartinez

title: fix: memory leak in dashboard component
body:
## Problem
Event listeners were not being cleaned up on component unmount.

## Solution
Added proper cleanup in useEffect hooks.

Fixes #146
